ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence screening of all UBOs, general partner officers, and authorized signatories against the BMA consolidated sanctions list, UK HM Treasury OFSI list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, US OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, and EU consolidated sanctions. Politically Exposed Persons are screened using commercial AML databases; PEP status is not disqualifying but requires senior management approval, documented source-of-funds verification, and ongoing transaction monitoring under the Proceeds of Crime (AML/CFT) Regulations 2008, Part II.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies official name clearance and online reservation portal, operated by the Registry General (Bermuda Government), accessible via the Companies Registry e-services platform.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Bermuda statutory documentation is in English only. Names must use Latin (English) script; phonetic transliteration is not accepted for statutory filing. An exempted limited partnership name must end with 'Limited Partnership', 'L.P.', or 'LP'. Names must not be misleadingly similar to an existing registered entity, trademark, or official Bermuda Government designation.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bermuda (when used alone or implying state endorsement)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 days of the written rejection notice, the applicant may file a formal written appeal with the Registrar of Companies, including a legal submission under the Companies Act 1981 section 25 (as applied to exempted partnerships) and any consent letters from the competent minister where a sensitive token is indispensable to the corporate object. If the Registrar maintains the refusal, the applicant may apply to the Supreme Court of Bermuda for judicial review promptly and in any event within 3 months from the date of final refusal. A revised name application may be filed without prejudice immediately, which is ordinarily the fastest commercial remedy.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for the statutory registered office. The ELP must at all times maintain a physical registered office in Bermuda at the office of its licensed resident agent. Back-office, engineering, manufacturing, and warehousing functions relating to turbine-driven ICU ventilators may lawfully be conducted outside Bermuda, provided the ELP retains the Bermuda resident agent, Bermuda counsel, and local registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate risk of between 15% and 25% per annum. The Bermuda Monetary Authority and the licensed corporate service provider are empowered to conduct unannounced or spot-check inspections for AML/CFT compliance, suspicious transaction reporting, and record-keeping. Given the Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML tier applicable to medical-device hardware manufacturing with Government LC and SWIFT Wire payment rails, on-site verification demand is statistically elevated compared with pure holding vehicles.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 1883 (as amended), sections 4-8 (registration of exempted limited partnerships); Limited Partnerships Act 1883 (as amended); where the general partner is a corporate body, the Companies Act 1981 applies to such general partner.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Corporate Registry, Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (Ministry of Finance)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form ELP-1 — Application for Registration of an Exempted Limited Partnership under the Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 1883, together with the registered office and registered agent consents.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is prescribed; capital contributions are determined solely by the limited partnership agreement. No escrow account is required under Bermuda law. An annual government fee is calculated based on the amount of contributed capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscription and contribution schedule for the exempted limited partnership interest in the ELP is approved, and the general partner consents to the admission of the initial limited partner. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the ELP is established at the office of the resident representative in Bermuda, which is hereby appointed as agent for service of process. RESOLVED, that [●] is appointed as the initial authorised representative and signatory, with full power to execute, submit and notarise all statutory registration filings, to engage the resident agent, to open banking accounts and to complete all initial corporate governance and regulatory compliance steps for the ELP.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Preliminary Due Diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Registry, Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an electronic name reservation request for the proposed exempted limited partnership name (ending in 'L.P.') using the Bermuda Registry e-Services portal. Provide notarized identity documents of the general partner and, if a corporate general partner, a certificate of good standing. Await the reserved-name confirmation letter before preparing the registration application.
required_dossiers: Notarized passport copy of each general partner (or certificate of good standing for corporate general partner)
Bank/solvency reference letter (if required by the Registrar)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or variant-conflicted, file a written objection or submit up to three alternative names. Any adverse determination can be appealed to the Registrar within 14 days under section 18 of the Companies Act 1981 (applied mutatis mutandis).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Certificate of Registration / Statutory Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda (Registry General, Ministry of Finance)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and execute Form ELP-1 — Application for Registration of an Exempted Limited Partnership, including the particulars of the general partner, main place of business, registered office, and registered agent. Notarize the application and simultaneously file the executed limited partnership agreement (or draft) together with consent letters. Submit online with the registration fee.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Exempted Limited Partnership Agreement (or draft execution)
Consent to act as registered agent and office holder
Consent of general partner to appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond to the Registrar's comments within 14 days. Re-file corrected documents; any rejection may be cured by an amended application and, if still contentious, an appeal to the Minister of Finance under the Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 1883 (as amended).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment, Certificate Issuance and Registry Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, pay the registration and license fees (BMD 1,780) via wire or government portal. The Registrar will issue the Certificate of Registration and enter the ELP in the Register of Exempted Limited Partnerships. Download the certificate and produce certified copies for corporate banking.
required_dossiers: Beneficial ownership declaration for local BO register (form may be demanded at this stage)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Delays in issuance may be escalated through the Registry's service desk; obtain an interim confirmation letter. If registry entry is incorrect, apply for correction under the rectification provision of ELPA s.27.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Governance Setup and Regulatory Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies; Office of the Tax Commissioner; Bermuda Monetary Authority (for AML/ATF filing where applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appoint the corporate secretary and registered agent to file the beneficial ownership return, obtain a Corporate Income Tax identifier (if applicable), adopt the partnership accounting reference date, and open bank accounts with licensed banks. Prepare the initial AML/CFT risk assessment and designate the Money Laundering Reporting Officer.
required_dossiers: AML/CFT compliance policy and risk assessment
Notice of relevant person under the Proceeds of Crime (Amendment) Act 2020 (where applicable)
Confirmation of registered agent and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the B.O. filing is queried, file a corrective disclosure within 21 days to avoid penalties. If a tax clearance or banking verification is refused, withdraw and remedy deficiencies (e.g., enhanced due diligence) and re-submit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Health, Government of Bermuda – Drugs, Devices and Pharmacy Section
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Devices Manufacturing Licence (Invasive Ventilator, Class IIb/III) under the Pharmacy and Poisons (Medical Devices) Regulations 2023 and the Medical Devices Act 2020 (Bermuda)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Ministry of Public Works, Government of Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – Environmental Assessment (Screening with Site-Specific EIA) required; Full Public EIA mandatory if production capacity exceeds 10,000 units per year or if VOC emissions exceed 5 t/yr.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: BOD5 ≤ 25 mg/L, TSS ≤ 30 mg/L, pH 6.0–9.0, total residual chlorine ≤ 0.1 mg/L; Air: VOC ≤ 50 mg/m3, particulate matter ≤ 20 mg/m3; Hazardous waste manifesting and disposal under the Hazardous Waste Management Regulations 2008.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service (Fire Safety and Building Act 2004); structural load certification from the Department of Planning; occupational health and safety clearance under the Workplace Health and Safety Act 2008; emergency response and evacuation plan certified by the Civil Defence/Disaster Risk Management Unit.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda Office of the Tax Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Hamilton. Online portal: www.gov.bm (e-Tax services via MyBermuda).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Bermuda does not operate a general income tax or VAT registration system. A Bermuda Tax Reference (BTR) number is issued only when an entity registers as an employer for payroll tax (within 14 days of first local hire). To import/export goods, the entity must register with the Bermuda Customs Department for a Customs Business Number (CBN). Under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023, a foreign-owned multinational enterprise group with EUR 750M+ annual revenue must register for Bermuda Corporate Income Tax (CIT) and obtain a CIT Reference Number; otherwise, no tax ID is required for the ELP itself.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible; territorial scope (Bermuda does not tax income derived outside Bermuda); no entity-level income tax for Ordinary or Exempted Limited Partnerships
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: 1) Under the Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act 2023, a partnership may elect to be treated as a CIT taxable entity instead of look-through. 2) For foreign tax purposes, an ELP may make a US check-the-box election on Form 8832 to be taxed as a corporation or partnership. 3) Bermuda permits election for separate legal personality (subject to partnership agreement).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST or sales/use tax. Bermuda imposes customs import duties and limited service taxes (e.g., 10% hotel occupancy tax). Exports are not subject to any Bermuda indirect tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A – no VAT/GST registration threshold. Any person engaging in import/export must obtain a Customs Business Number (CBN) regardless of turnover; customs duty applies to imported goods.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, or digital stamping. Bermuda Customs uses the ACROSS single-entry system; commercial invoices, packing lists, and bills of lading must be submitted electronically for import/export declarations.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. Bermuda has no VAT/GST and does not impose export taxes. Goods and services destined for foreign markets are outside the scope of Bermuda's indirect taxation; therefore, no zero-rating claim or refund mechanism exists.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bermuda Customs Form C60 for controlled exports)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate (only where invoicing is routed through Bermuda financial institutions; not for Bermuda tax purposes)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: As there is no VAT, there are no zero-rating clawback penalties. However, false export declarations or customs documentation violations are penalized under the Customs Act 1965 (up to the value of goods, forfeiture, or imprisonment). The CIT Act 2023 imposes penalties on in-scope MNEs for tax avoidance transactions (up to 100% of underpaid CIT), but no indirect-tax export fraud regime exists.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermudian dollar (BMD) is pegged at 1:1 to the US dollar (USD) and is fully convertible for both current-account and capital-account transactions. Bermuda operates a liberalised exchange-control regime under the Exchange Control Act 1972, administered by the BMA, with standing general permissions allowing unrestricted inward foreign direct investment, profit remittance, dividend distributions and capital repatriation by non-resident Exempted Limited Partnerships (ELPs). The ELP may invoice, settle and retain proceeds in USD, EUR or GBP without BMA approval. Profit remittance is subject only to standard audited-account substantiation and the protections of the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966; no economic-substance or balance-of-payments justification can be invoked to defer or block dividend distributions to the UK/European limited partners. The practical constraint is not convertibility but bank-side documentary proof of source of funds and beneficial ownership of the ventilator-manufacturing ELP.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender obligation is imposed on Bermuda ELPs. There is no BMA mandate to convert export receipts into BMD, no fixed repatriation timeline, no minimum conversion ratio and no requirement to hold export sale proceeds onshore. The ELP may freely hold export collections in USD, EUR or GBP either in Bermuda or at offshore correspondent accounts. Authorised dealers (Bermuda licensed banks) retain monitoring duties, but the BMA does not impose invoice-level surrender or reporting timelines on non-resident ELPs engaged in ISIC 3250 exports.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited (Butterfield)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (multi-currency USD/BMD/EUR) and segregated Capital Escrow Account for partnership subscriptions
Operational Account with HSBC Global Trade and Receivables Finance desk; Capital Escrow Account linked to HSBC London for UK LP funding
Operational Account and dedicated investment/escrow suite for partnership capital
Operational Account for private-banking treasury flows

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low for a Bermuda-domiciled fintech/EMI as the primary settlement bank; Medium-to-High for an FCA-authorised UK Electronic Money Institution (EMI) as a collection-only rail for EU/UK government tender proceeds. Bermuda's Digital Asset Business Act 2018 creates a digital-asset business licence, not an e-money/clearing institution licence, so a Bermuda-licensed fintech cannot legally execute SWIFT MT103 or act as a reimbursing bank for documentary letters of credit. A UK FCA EMI (regulated under the Electronic Money Regulations 2011) may be used for GBP/EUR receivables collection with strict safeguarding rules, but it must not be used for the final leg of LC discounting or for holding escrowed equity capital, which requires a full commercial-bank counterparty in Bermuda.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under Bermuda's Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2008, Bermuda licensed banks apply enhanced due diligence to offshore ELPs with non-resident partners. In practice, at least one controlling principal (the General Partner's Responsible Individual or an authorised UK-resident manager) must attend an in-person verification interview at the bank's Bermuda premises, or at a recognised international private-banking centre in London/New York operated by the same banking group. Remote onboarding is permitted only on an exceptional basis involving a live video interview with a UK notary, apostilled certified copies, a Bermuda counsel legal opinion confirming the General Partner's authority, and independent source-of-funds verification. The interview mandate is a bank-policy reflection of the 2008 Regulations, not a statutory interview, but directors/managers should budget for physical attendance to avoid a 4-8 week account-opening delay.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity of the ELP structure: multiple non-resident limited partners, discretionary interests, and a corporate General Partner
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bermuda Beneficial Ownership Register filing confirmation; certified partnership deed with LP schedule identifying legal owners, percentage interests and residency status; organisational chart from the General Partner down to every natural person holding more than 10% of economic rights; UK PSC (persons of significant control) annex for any UK-resident LP; notarised declaration of source of wealth per LP together with the originating bank statement covering the initial capital commitment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sector red flag: ISIC 3250 critical-care mechanical ventilators are classified as enhanced-risk medical hardware subject to UK Export Control Order 2008, US FDA establishment registration and EU/UK MDR scrutiny
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GP compliance manifesto stating the ELP acts solely as manufacturer/holding entity; CE marking technical file under EU 2017/745 (Class IIb) and UKCA certificate from MHRA; ISO 13485:2016 quality-management certificate; US FDA Establishment Registration and Device Listing confirmation; signed end-use undertaking confirming ventilators are supplied to licensed public hospitals and not to sanctioned or embargoed destinations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection from UK/Europe arriving without a contemporaneous trade contract, creating equity-versus-procurement ambiguity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed capital contribution agreement and deed of adherence; exempted partnership registration certificate issued by the Registrar of Companies; audited opening equity schedule with source-of-funds bank statements; General Partner board resolution approving the exact USD/BMD capital quantum and account designation; wire reference carrying ISO 20022 purpose code EQUI with end-beneficiary passport copies for non-publicly listed remitters.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume outbound payments to government hospitals, NGO intermediaries and LC beneficiaries triggering sanctions-screening hits and transaction-review notifications
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Government procurement contract award notice or UN/World Bank vendor registration; invoices cross-referenced to airway bills, delivery signatures and inspection certificates; supplier sub-certification confirming the ultimate consignee is not listed on the UK HM Treasury Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List or EU asset-freeze list; copy of the underlying irrevocable letter of credit or standby LC wording.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route via SWIFT MT103 from the UK/European limited partner's corporate account to the Bermuda bank's US-dollar correspondent (typically New York, via HSBC or Butterfield's nostro) with remittance field stating: 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION - KY_ELP - ISIC 3250 MECHANICAL VENTILATOR'. Use SWIFT GPI for end-to-end tracking; populate field 50F (ordering customer), field 57A (beneficiary bank) and field 59 (beneficiary: KY_ELP Exempted LP in the exact BMD/USD account name); use ISO 20022 purpose code 'EQUI' in field 70. Pre-notify the Bermuda account officer with the signed capital agreement and source-of-funds file before first credit to avoid a hold under the Banks and Deposit Companies Act 1999. For any remittance routed through a non-OECD intermediary, include a comprehensive source-of-wealth narrative in field 72 to survive correspondent-bank compliance filters.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 in USD for component procurement and engineering royalties; (2) irrevocable commercial documentary letter of credit (UCP600) issued/advised through Butterfield or HSBC's trade-finance corridor for UK/EU/Commonwealth state buyers, including government-issued LC programmes for ICU ventilators; (3) TARGET2/SEPA Instant for EUR-denominated reimbursements from EU health ministries; (4) local BMD clearing via the Bermuda Automated Clearing House for on-island operational expenses at the fixed 1:1 BMD/USD exchange rate. Each outbound disbursement must carry invoice numbers, export-licence references or waiver certificates in the SWIFT narrative to survive BMA transaction monitoring and US/UK correspondent-bank sanctions screening; the ELP should obtain an MT103 acknowledgment from the beneficiary bank for every trade payment exceeding USD 100,000.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards up to 12 months in EUR/USD, GBP/USD and USD/BMD (the BMD leg only for peg-floor notional protection) under an ISDA 2002 master agreement with a BMA-licensed or UK FCA-authorised bank counterparty
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on CNY/USD and INR/USD where the ELP sells to Asian government procurement agencies operating under restricted currency convertibility
Cross-currency swaps (USD principal versus GBP or EUR floating, 6-month reset) to hedge UK bridge financing and future subordinated debt obligations
Plain vanilla FX options (EUR put / USD call) on EU government tender receivables, premium settled in USD

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Bermuda Exempted Partnership Annual Renewal: annual government fee payment plus confirmation of registered office, registered agent and general partner particulars
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 January for the calendar year ending 31 December; the Registrar-issued annual fee invoice is payable by 31 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A 10% late-payment surcharge on the annual fee applies after 31 January; continued non-payment after 30 June can lead to administrative removal or strike-off from the Register of Exempted Partnerships, terminating valid registration and the entity's limited liability shield.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Bermuda Annual Economic Substance Declaration under the Economic Substance Act 2018
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority via the Bermuda Government online filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after each financial year-end; required annually even where the ELP does not carry on a Bermuda relevant activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing is an offence: fixed penalty up to BMD 10,000, default-penalty order of BMD 10,000 for each unremitted default, court-ordered filing, criminal fines and, for repeated non-compliance, administrative strike-off or other Registrar enforcement action.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Return and Register Confirmation for in-scope Bermuda exempted partnerships
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority Beneficial Ownership Register / Registrar of Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No standalone annual UBO filing date for undertakings without changes; changes in beneficial ownership or registered BO particulars must be filed within 14 days of the change, with an annual refresh made at renewal if a transfer or assignment occurred during the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to keep the BO register accurate or to notify within 14 days may lead to fines up to BMD 25,000 and imprisonment for two years; continued non-compliance may trigger inspection and strike-off proceedings at the Registrar's discretion.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Not applicable under Bermuda law for an Exempted Limited Partnership; no compulsory statutory audit exists based on revenue, assets, employees or number of partners. An audit becomes mandatory only if required by the Limited Partnership Agreement, a fund prospectus, a regulated-fund licence condition, or an investor or lender covenant.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory Bermuda statutory accounting framework applies; if accounts are voluntarily prepared they are commonly presented under IFRS or US GAAP for investor and tax reporting purposes and need not be filed with the Registrar of Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Bermuda has no mechanical annual UBO confirmation for all ELPs. The ELP must maintain a current Register of Beneficial Owners at its registered office and file any change in beneficial ownership or registered details with the BMA BO register within 14 days. Because an ELP has no share capital, transfers or assignments of partnership interests are recorded by updating the Register of Limited Partners and, where applicable, the BO register; an annual confirmatory resolution is a governance requirement under the LPA rather than a separate Government filing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Beneficial Owners (if in-scope under the Bermuda Beneficial Ownership Acts)
Minute book containing partner resolutions, consents and registered-office records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 0 if no contractual audit is required; 35,000-85,000 if an IFRS or US-GAAP certified audit is required by the LPA or investors

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% for in-scope MNE groups only (consolidated group revenue at least EUR 750 million in at least two of the preceding four fiscal years); zero percent for all other exempted limited partnerships.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holidays. Effective relief is available through the Substance-Based Income Exclusion (SBIE) on eligible payroll (8% transitional rate) and eligible tangible ventilator-manufacturing assets (5% transitional rate), Qualifying Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax (QDMTT) credits, and the three-year transitional CbCR Safe Harbour.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Form CIT-1 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed via the Bermuda Tax Administration System (TAS) electronic portal at https://portal.taxation.gov.bm.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due 15 months after the fiscal-year end; the initial in-scope year (fiscal periods beginning on or after 1 January 2025) is due 18 months after the fiscal-year end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT Reference Number and registered name of the exempted limited partnership.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident General Partner must insert the Bermuda registered office's agent code and maintain a current power of attorney in TAS.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year-end date and length of accounting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the ELP's audited consolidated financial-year date; do not default to the partners' tax years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: MNE group scoping test: ultimate parent entity, revenue threshold test, and CbCR jurisdiction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the ELP is tax-transparent, attach a partner attribution schedule; only non-resident partners' Bermuda-source allocated income is reportable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bermuda-derived taxable income (BMD) after adjustments per the CIT Act accounting rules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only income retained at the ELP level net of allocations to non-resident partners that are not subject to Bermuda income tax.

For in-scope ELPs, losses are carried forward 30 years under the Bermuda CIT Act; for transparent ELPs outside scope, losses flow through to partners and are not claimed at the ELP level; attach GL loss computations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: SBIE, QDMTT credits, and elections applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident partners cannot claim SBIE on the ELP's return; SBIE belongs solely to the constituent entity conducting payroll and tangible-asset activities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net CIT payable at 15% with currency conversion at the Bermuda Monetary Authority rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay via TAS in BMD; SWIFT wire remittances must include the CIT reference to avoid late-payment interest.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration by the authorized General Partner representative.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident signatories must present a wet-ink or certified electronic signature and a verified Bermuda address for service.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fixed penalty BMD 10,000 plus BMD 1,000 per month (capped at 12 months), then BMD 2,000 per month; late payment: 4% p.a. interest plus 2% monthly default surcharge; willful non-filing or false return: fine up to BMD 250,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years.
